quick_skim.title: LC-TSRNet: A Land-Cover-Guided Two-Stage Network for Annual MODIS Surface Reflectance Time Series Reconstruction
quick_skim.abstract: MODIS surface reflectance (SR) products often suffer from data gaps due to cloud contamination and sensor malfunctions, limiting their applications in long-term and large-scale studies. Most existing methods rely on cloud-free observations from optical time series or introduce SAR time series as auxiliary information. However, due to the coarse spatial resolution of MODIS, cloud-free reference images are difficult to obtain, and SAR imagery is not well matched to the spatial resolution of MODIS, making it difficult to provide effective prior constraints. To address these issues, this study proposes LC-TSRNet for seamless reconstruction of annual MODIS SR products. In the first stage, an annual land cover map is introduced as prior knowledge, and CSPM is designed by leveraging the spectral similarity within identical land cover types, thereby providing prior spectral constraints for missing regions. In the second stage, to address large-area, persistent, and overlapping gaps in MODIS imagery, SMRM is designed to adaptively exploit and integrate multi-scale spatiotemporal contextual information. Meanwhile, to address the limited collaborative utilization of spatio-temporal-spectral information, 3DAM is designed to impose cross-dimensional joint constraints. Considering the lack of publicly available MODIS sample datasets, this study constructs the AIRMOD-TSR dataset. Extensive experimental results show that LC-TSRNet outperforms the comparison methods and achieves better reconstruction accuracy and spectral fidelity. Under the spatially adjacent scenario, LC-TSRNet improves PSNR by 0.56 dB and reduces SAM by 0.13°. The vegetation monitoring application further verifies the practical value of the reconstructed SR time series.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: LC-TSRNet reconstructs annual MODIS surface reflectance time series using an annual land-cover map as prior guidance, addressing cloud gaps and auxiliary-data mismatch to support long-term land-cover change monitoring.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对MODIS地表反射率产品因云污染和传感器故障存在数据缺口、现有重建方法难以获得有效无云参考和SAR空间匹配先验的问题，本文提出LC-TSRNet两阶段重建网络。该方法引入年度土地覆盖图作为先验约束，引导MODIS地表反射率时间序列的无缝重建。研究旨在生成更完整的年度反射率产品，为长时序、大尺度土地覆盖变化监测与分析提供数据基础。
